subject: pixelDungeonProps
pitch:
Category: Prop group.
Subject: dungeon props: chest, torches, barrels, bones, spike trap.
Style: pixel art.
reasoning:
I'm planning a pixel art dungeon prop group using the tile/texture kit, laying out a static scene centered at the origin with a chest, barrels, standing torches, a bone pile, and a spike trap arranged around a central floor space.

For the chest, I'm stacking boxes to form a stepped lid and body with iron bands and a gold lock plate using cellPaint colors, then placing two differently sized barrels nearby using octagonal cylinder geometry.

Barrels are built from stacked tapered cylinder segments to fake a bulging wood barrel shape, with thin iron hoops and a dark top disk. For torches, I'm making a wooden post on a stone base with an iron bracket holding crossed flame-textured cards with a glow effect, positioned symmetrically on either side of the scene.

Now I'm scattering a bone pile—a skull with eye sockets and jaw, long bones as shafts with knobbed ends, and a few curved rib arcs—using rotated boxes for variety, then starting on a spike trap built from a stone base plate.

Writing wood grain paint logic...

Now I'm setting up the chest with a tiled plank box texture, scaled so the texel density stays reasonable, and designing an 8x12 pixel-art flame texture using warm palette rows, placed on multiple rotated planes so the flame is visible from all sides.

For the bone material, I'm giving it a bone-white color (#e8e0c8) with cell-shaded paint ramp shading.
